essence: The rite begins by seating the girl before the deity and then worshipping her.
The girl is satisfied with banana, coconut, and similar fruits.
One chants the mantra according to ability, increasing by one each time, or otherwise as stated.
After saluting her as the deity, one dismisses her.
Thus on the tithi one worships the maiden chosen on the previous day.
